authority.rule: Municipalities and school districts may elect design-build; use is not mandatory.

notice.rule: Online notice of intent is required at least 14 days before the RFP.

rfp.rule: The RFP must disclose schedule, budget, funding source, available funds, prequalification, material terms, performance criteria, evaluation criteria, and Phase II field size.

scope.rule: A licensed design professional or public art designer must assist with scope and performance criteria.

scope_conflict.rule: The scope-preparing professional may not participate in a design-build proposal for that project.

selection.rule: Phase I is qualifications-based with no price; Phase II evaluates technical and cost factors; total-project-cost weighting is capped at 30%.

municipal_shortlist.rule: The ordinary municipal Phase II shortlist is two to six entities. If only one Phase I response is received, the municipality may evaluate that single respondent in Phase II if, in its discretion, it finds proceeding to be in its best interest.

timing.rule: RFP-to-proposal minimum is 21 days, or 28 days above $12 million; Phase II development minimum is 30 days.

small_projects.rule: Combined evaluation is permitted below $12 million for municipalities and at $12 million or less for schools if all evaluation requirements remain.

impropriety.rule: An entity may not be considered where interests or relationships create tangible advantage or appearance of impropriety.

reporting.rule: The awardee reports every six months and before final payout on specified utilization-goal efforts and success.
